# Feedback {.unnumbered}

If you have any feedback on the book (errors, lack of clarity, etc) or on the class (issues with tests, etc) please use the form below.  The form below is **completely anonymous** — it does not record your name or email and you do not need to sign in. Note that this is not the best way to ask for help, as I have no idea who sent in the feedback.  

You can also reach me directly at [peter.slade@usask.ca](mailto:peter.slade@usask.ca).
